requirements.quote:
Because the ClientHello indicates the time at which the client sent
   it, it is possible to efficiently determine whether a ClientHello was
   likely sent reasonably recently and only accept 0-RTT for such a
   ClientHello, otherwise falling back to a 1-RTT handshake.
requirements.condition: when implementing the freshness-check mechanism for 0-RTT
requirements.required_behavior: accept 0-RTT only for a ClientHello determined to have been sent reasonably recently
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accept 0-RTT for a ClientHello that fails the freshness determination
requirements.why_checkable: Controlled ticket ages and server time can verify that only ClientHellos within the configured freshness range receive 0-RTT.

requirements.quote:
Because the ClientHello indicates the time at which the client sent
   it, it is possible to efficiently determine whether a ClientHello was
   likely sent reasonably recently and only accept 0-RTT for such a
   ClientHello, otherwise falling back to a 1-RTT handshake.
requirements.condition: when a ClientHello fails the 0-RTT freshness determination
requirements.error_behavior: reject 0-RTT while allowing the 1-RTT handshake path
requirements.why_checkable: An out-of-window ClientHello can verify that the handshake continues without early-data acceptance.

requirements.quote:
In order to implement this mechanism, a server needs to store the
   time that the server generated the session ticket, offset by an
   estimate of the round-trip time between client and server.
requirements.condition: when a server implements the described 0-RTT freshness mechanism
requirements.required_behavior: retain the session-ticket creation time offset by an estimated client-server round-trip time
requirements.why_checkable: Ticket state or ticket contents can be inspected for the adjusted creation-time value.

requirements.condition: when calculating adjusted_creation_time for a session ticket
requirements.required_behavior: set adjusted_creation_time to creation_time plus estimated_RTT
requirements.why_checkable: Known creation-time and RTT inputs can verify the arithmetic result.

requirements.quote:
The server can determine the
   client's view of the age of the ticket by subtracting the ticket's
   "ticket_age_add" value from the "obfuscated_ticket_age" parameter in
   the client's "pre_shared_key" extension.
requirements.condition: when determining clients_ticket_age from a ClientHello pre_shared_key identity
requirements.why_checkable: Controlled ticket_age_add and obfuscated_ticket_age inputs can verify the recovered client ticket age.

requirements.quote:
The server can determine
   the expected_arrival_time of the ClientHello as:

     expected_arrival_time = adjusted_creation_time + clients_ticket_age
requirements.condition: when calculating expected_arrival_time for a ClientHello
requirements.required_behavior: set expected_arrival_time to adjusted_creation_time plus clients_ticket_age
requirements.why_checkable: Known adjusted creation time and client ticket age can verify the expected arrival-time result.

requirements.quote:
When a new ClientHello is received, the expected_arrival_time is then
   compared against the current server wall clock time
requirements.condition: when a server receives a new ClientHello for freshness checking
requirements.required_behavior: compare expected_arrival_time with the current server wall-clock time
requirements.why_checkable: The freshness decision can be exercised under a controlled wall clock and expected arrival time.

requirements.quote:
When a new ClientHello is received, the expected_arrival_time is then
   compared against the current server wall clock time and if they
   differ by more than a certain amount, 0-RTT is rejected, though the
   1-RTT handshake can be allowed to complete.
requirements.condition: when expected_arrival_time and current server wall-clock time differ by more than the configured permissible amount
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accept early data for the out-of-range ClientHello
requirements.error_behavior: reject 0-RTT while permitting the implementation to continue with 1-RTT
requirements.why_checkable: Clock differences just inside and outside the configured threshold can verify the decision boundary.

requirements.quote:
In addition, this
   freshness checking is only done at the time the ClientHello is
   received and not when subsequent early Application Data records are
   received.
requirements.condition: when performing the specified 0-RTT freshness check
requirements.required_behavior: perform the check when the ClientHello is received
requirements.why_checkable: Instrumentation can verify the protocol event at which the freshness calculation and decision occur.

requirements.quote:
In addition, this
   freshness checking is only done at the time the ClientHello is
   received and not when subsequent early Application Data records are
   received.
requirements.condition: when subsequent early Application Data records arrive after the ClientHello freshness decision
requirements.required_behavior: retain the ClientHello-time freshness decision for those records
requirements.forbidden_behavior: perform the specified freshness check again on each subsequent early Application Data record
requirements.why_checkable: Instrumentation can verify that later early-data records do not trigger another ClientHello freshness calculation.
